newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berliner Elektro 96 loss 75-80 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Berliner Elektro 96 loss 75-80 mln DM.

text.p: Berliner Elektro Holding AG said on Monday it expected a 1996 parent company loss of 75 million to 80 million marks as a result of extraordinary restructuring costs.
The company also said it expected 1997 group revenue to rise eight percent to two billion marks.
In 1996 group revenue rose 13 percent to 1.85 billion marks ($1.2 billion), but the increase was offset by 50 million marks in restructuring charges before taxes.
The company has been reorganising to focus on its core areas. It said its transportation, electronics, and bank technology units should drive revenue growth in 1997.
Its semiconductor technology unit (BESI) was expected to continue to see weak demand in the first half of this year.
